app.title: Board games
app.tagline: Play board games online with friends.

sky-team.name: Sky Team
sky-team.blurb: Two players, cooperative: land the plane together without talking.

gate.intro: Private site. Enter the password to play.
gate.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
gate.error: The server did not answer. Try again.

account.signInIntro: Optional: your Flight Log and your seat follow you to your other devices. Guests play as before.
account.nameIntro: Other players see it in every game. You can change it later from your account menu.
account.nameFromAccount: Your account's name. Change it from the account menu.
account.deleteIntro: This removes your account, your sign-ins and your whole Flight Log from the server. It cannot be undone. Games in progress keep going, with your seat as a guest.

lobby.sendCode: Send them this code or the invite link.

toast.noAnswer: The server did not answer. Check your connection.
toast.partnerLeft: {{name}} left the game. Share the code to fly with someone else.
toast.partnerOffline: {{name}} lost connection. Their seat is kept for them.

errors.room-full: That game already has two players.
errors.bad-token: Your seat could not be restored.
errors.not-in-room: You are not in a game.
errors.already-in-room: You are already in a game.
errors.game-not-over: The game is not over yet.
errors.unknown-game: This server does not host that game.
errors.stale-match: That game has moved on: your screen is up to date again, try once more.
errors.too-many-rooms: You have too many open games. Finish or leave one first.
errors.not-creator: Only the game’s creator chooses the seats.

history.title: My history
history.intro: Every game you played while signed in, from any device.
history.signedOut: Sign in to see your history on all your devices.
